C1477.title: People v. Li (2023) Virtual Land Sales Fraud Case
C1477.summary: In 2023, a virtual real estate fraud case occurred in California. The defendant Li sold virtual land to buyers on a metaverse platform but did not actually hold legal ownership of the land, causing buyers to suffer deception.
